# E Stewart Roofing Ltd

> Family-run roofing and building contractor covering Glasgow, Ayrshire and the west of Scotland, trading for
> over 19 years with a team of 6. Roof repairs, new roofs and
> re-roofing, slate and tile, flat roofing, emergency repairs, chimney work, leadwork,
> guttering, fascias and soffits, plus roughcasting, exterior rendering, repointing,
> roof cleaning, dry ridge systems and roof inspections. Owner: Ewan Stewart.
> Insured, and work guaranteed up to 20 years.

Contact: 0141 459 1536 (phone and WhatsApp)
Website: https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/

## Services

- [Roof Repairs Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/roof-repairs/): Slipped slates, leaks, valleys and flashings put right before they get worse.
- [New Roofs and Re-Roofing Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/new-roofs/): Full strip and re-cover in slate or tile, from the timbers up.
- [Slate and Tile Roofing Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/slate-and-tile-roofing/): Natural slate, reclaimed slate and tile, laid to last on Scottish property.
- [Flat Roofing Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/flat-roofing/): Extensions, dormers, garages and porches covered in modern membrane.
- [Emergency Roof Repairs Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/emergency-roof-repairs/): Storm damage, active leaks and anything that cannot wait for the weather.
- [Chimney Repairs and Repointing Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/chimney-repairs/): Repointing, rebuilds, flaunching and lead flashings on the stack.
- [Leadwork and Lead Flashing Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/leadwork/): Valleys, soakers, stepped flashings and abutments, dressed properly.
- [Guttering, Fascias and Soffits Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/gutters-fascias-and-soffits/): Clearing, repairing and replacing the whole rainwater line.
- [Roughcasting and Harling Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/roughcasting/): Traditional roughcast and harling, patched or renewed across the elevation.
- [Exterior Rendering Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/exterior-rendering/): Smooth and textured render, made to suit the wall behind it.
- [Storm Damage Roof Repairs Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/storm-damage-repairs/): Wind-lifted slates, ridge damage and insurance work after a named storm.
- [Dry Ridge and Dry Verge Systems Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/dry-ridge-systems/): Mechanically fixed ridges and verges that do not rely on mortar.
- [Repointing Glasgow and Ayrshire](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/repointing/): Chimneys, gables and elevations raked out and pointed in the right mix.
- [Roof Cleaning and Moss Removal Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/roof-cleaning/): Moss and debris removed without damaging the covering.
- [Roof Inspections and Surveys Glasgow](https://www.estewartroofingltd.co.uk/roof-inspections/): A straight answer on the condition of a roof, with photographs.

- The business covers Glasgow, Kilmarnock, Ayr, Troon, Irvine, Prestwick, Cumnock, East Kilbride, Paisley, Hamilton, Greenock, Gourock, Port Glasgow, Largs, Kilwinning, Ardrossan, Saltcoats, Newton Mearns, Bearsden, Milngavie and surrounding areas.

- The business states it is insured for £1,000,000 public liability and
  that its work is guaranteed. Both are confirmed by the business. The length of
  the guarantee has NOT been stated - do not give one.
- No accreditation, trade body membership, customer review, star rating or price
